scientific.integrity: The direct support-function source and the sequel defining the circumscribed equilateral family were materially inspected, as was the closest minimum-enclosing-triangle source. Searches covered equivalent geometric terminology and exact formula fingerprints. The proof is analytic; the bundled computation independently reconstructs support-line triangles as a regression check.
limitations: The theorem concerns equilateral support triangles only and does not determine the unrestricted minimum enclosing triangle when the side count is not divisible by three.
The fact that regular polygons with side count divisible by three have an equilateral global minimum enclosing triangle is prior work.
An equivalent short calculation may exist in older rotor or circumscribed-polygon literature.
A later circumscribed-equiangular-polygon source was available only at abstract level for comparison.

title: Exact circumscribed-equilateral-triangle spectrum of every regular polygon
